## 1. Scope, authority and reading order

### 1.1 What Prompt 09C is for

B-09 states **what the Alliance rules are**. This companion states **how a player or the engine moves through them**: who may act, in what order, what is shown before confirmation, what happens at a boundary, what is refused, what is recorded, what a later build must prove, and what another Stage 2 prompt may safely assume.

It exists so that Prompts 10 (warfare), 12 (fair play, privacy and administration), 13 (interface), 14 (formulas) and 15 (Bible assembly) can consume the Alliance system **without reinterpreting a rule, inventing a workflow, guessing a value or promoting a candidate into an approved mechanic**.

### 1.2 What this document owns, and what it does not

| Question | Authoritative owner | This document's role |
|---|---|---|
| What is the Alliance rule? | [B-09](16_alliances.md) | Cites it; never restates a conflicting version |
| How is a number computed? | [Formula register](16_alliances_formula_register.md) | Supplies arithmetic scenarios; changes no value |
| What must another subsystem provide? | [Integration contracts](16_alliances_integration_contracts.md) | Names the dependency; invents no interface beyond `AX-01`–`AX-30` |
| Is a requirement Approved, Provisional, Open or Deferred? | [Requirements register](03_requirements_traceability.md) | Preserves the status; adds no requirement |
| Is a decision approved, candidate or owner-reserved? | [04](04_approved_and_provisional_decisions.md), [05](05_unresolved_design_decisions.md), [DECISIONS](../DECISIONS.md) | Records the dependency; decides nothing |
| Who acts, in what order, and what does the player see? | **This document**, §3–§8 | Owns the workflow layer |
| Which states and transitions exist? | **This document**, §4 and §6 | Reconciles B-09's rules into explicit state models; adds none |
| What must a test assert? | **This document**, §14 | Owns the acceptance matrix |
| What may a later implementation build? | **This document**, §18 | Names the boundary; implements nothing |

### 1.3 Reading order

1. [`ROADMAP.md`](../ROADMAP.md) and [`stage-2/01_stage_2_prompt_roadmap.md`](01_stage_2_prompt_roadmap.md) for the Stage 2 sequence and the Prompt 09C registration.

4. [Formula register](16_alliances_formula_register.md) `F-AL-001`–`F-AL-008`, with **`F-AL-006`–`F-AL-008` read in full**.
5. [Integration contracts](16_alliances_integration_contracts.md) `AX-01`–`AX-30`.
6. This document §2–§4 for semantics, authority and states; §5–§8 for workflows and journeys; §9–§14 for edge cases, failures, concurrency, notifications, security and tests; §15–§18 for traceability and handoff.

The four labels are never blurred, in this document or in anything that cites it.

| Label | Meaning | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| **Approved constraint** | An owner-authorized boundary or a binding inherited rule. It may be cited as in force *as a rule*; it is still not implemented. | Automatic per-turn production tax (`ALL-179`–`ALL-187`); donations (`ALL-188`–`ALL-195`); treaty object and NAP (`ALL-196`–`ALL-208`); same-Alliance ban (`ALL-209`–`ALL-215`); ARL invariant and narrow operational funding (`ALL-220`–`ALL-226`); conservation (`REQ-176`); national sovereignty (`B-08`, `REQ-530`); no chat (`D-133`); Global Trade gates (`D-122`, `G-1`–`G-6`) |

| **Binding design contract** | A cross-system obligation that a later prompt must implement. | `AX-30` and `ALL-213` for Prompt 10 attack validation |
| **Candidate proposal** | Written down, **not approved**, and not enforceable. It must be displayed with its `UD-` dependency. | Founding fee (`F-AL-002`, `UD-040`); single-alliance baseline (`ALL-019`, `UD-040`); roster cap (`ALL-085`, `UD-044`); rejoin cooldown (`F-AL-004`, `UD-044`); withdrawal and dual approval (`ALL-109`–`ALL-116`, `UD-046`); ballots (`ALL-129`–`ALL-135`, `UD-042`/`UD-049`); bulletins (`ALL-162`, `UD-049`); Discord link (`ALL-165`–`ALL-166`, `UD-048`) |

## 2. Canonical semantics used by every workflow

### 2.1 Actors and objects

| Actor / object | What it is | What it is **not** |
|---|---|---|
| **Nation owner** | The authenticated player who owns exactly one active nation (`ACC-001`, `REQ-061`) | Not interchangeable with an alliance, an office or an administrator |
| **Applicant** | A nation in `APPLICANT` with a `PENDING` application (`ALL-079`–`ALL-080`) | Not a member; not taxable; not covered by a treaty; cannot see private alliance data |
| **Active member** | A nation in `ACTIVE_MEMBER` (`ALL-079`) | Membership alone grants no permission, no tax rate and no treaty coverage |
| **Capability holder** | An active member whose **position** carries a named capability (`ALL-067`, `ALL-071`) | Not a rank, title or "officer" flag; titles carry no power (`ALL-048`) |
| **Primary Administrative Contact** | The active member designated as the technical notice endpoint and root administrative anchor (`ALL-015`) | Not a "Leader"; carries no inherent authority over members |
| **Alliance** | A persistent organisation record with a unique identity and `ACTIVE`/`DISSOLVED` lifecycle (`ALL-011`–`ALL-023`) | Not a player, not a sovereign, not an actor with independent will |
| **Donor** | The authenticated owner of a nation making a voluntary transfer (`ALL-188`–`ALL-190`) | Not an officer acting for the alliance |
| **Non-covered member** | An active member who declined or withheld consent to a specific `AT-T01` NAP (`ALL-199`, `ALL-204`) | Not a second-class member; admission, rights and standing are unchanged |
| **Foreign / non-member nation** | Any nation outside the alliance | Cannot read applicants, tax reports or private treaty terms |
| **Platform / engine** | The system performing only the automatic acts listed in §2.11 | Not a political actor; cannot choose a bracket, rate, recipient or consent |
| **AI or automation** | Any agent, script or model | Holds zero Alliance authority (`ALL-179`, `ALL-183`, `ALL-198`, `ALL-224`) |
| **Administrator** | Platform moderation and account authority | Cannot found, join, tax, approve, consent, vote or break for a player (`REQ-530`, `ALL-158`) |
| **Attack validator** | The single server-side function Prompt 10 must call (`ALL-210`–`ALL-213`) | Not a UI filter; not a client check; not a treaty display |

### 2.2 Four layers that are never collapsed

| Layer | Question it answers | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| **Rule** | Is this permitted, required or prohibited? | B-09, formula register, requirements |
| **Workflow** | Who does what, in what order, with what confirmation? | This document |
| **Control** | Which server-side check enforces it, and what does it record? | B-09 security rules; `AX-` contracts; Prompt 10/12 for their systems |
| **Decision** | Has the owner actually approved this capability or value? | `D-`, `DD-`, `UD-` registers |

A workflow may **describe** a candidate control. It may not **rely** on one as if approved. For example, the withdrawal workflow is described in §5 only to state that no general withdrawal exists while `UD-046` is Open; it confers no spending path.

### 2.3 The tax computation in one paragraph

For each active member at the frozen snapshot, for each asset, the engine reads that Alliance's bracket version and rate in **basis points** (`0`–`10,000`). Production events for the turn are indexed in the deterministic P3 order. Cumulative gross is `C_j = Σ g_k`; cumulative due is `D_j = floor(C_j × rate_bp / 10,000)`; the tax at event `j` is `D_j − D_{j−1}`; the turn tax is `D_m = floor(G × rate_bp / 10,000)` and the net is `G − D_m` (`F-AL-006`, `ALL-185`). **No per-event independent floor exists.** The base is **only** production generated during the turn (`ALL-180`): opening balances, existing stockpiles, donations, gifts, aid, reparations, market purchases, sale proceeds and other non-production inflows are never taxed. Crowns are taxed inside P3.1 after gross tax income and before P3.2; resources are taxed at their P3.3/P3.5 production events before any later same-turn consumption. A 100% rate is valid and leaves zero of that turn's production; it creates no debt and does not reach the opening balance.

### 2.4 The Alliance Receiving Ledger in one paragraph

The **ARL** is a **receipt and accounting record**, not a pool, not a wallet, not an ownership interest and not a custody arrangement (`ALL-187`, `ALL-225`). Per asset it reports four categories: `RECEIVED` (cumulative credits), `AVAILABLE` (unreserved, unexpended), `RESERVED` (allocated to a pending valid operational authorization) and `EXPENDED` (cumulative settled operational expenses). The invariant is:

`AVAILABLE = RECEIVED − RESERVED − EXPENDED`, with every category non-negative and conserved per asset.

The only debit path is the purpose-limited operational expense (`ALL-220`–`ALL-226`, `F-AL-008`), payable only to a **registered platform cost sink** for a registered `AOP-01`–`AOP-04` purpose under an approved cost schedule. **No cost schedule is approved**, so no purpose is currently spendable and every actual payment is blocked (`ALF-27`). General withdrawal, distribution, grants, loans, aid, reparations, refunds, dividends, salaries, prizes, ownership, custody, capacity and dual approval remain Open under `UD-046`.

### 2.5 Membership is not coverage

| Concept | Governed by | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| **Membership** | `ALL-079`–`ALL-086` | Applicant / active / former; roster, permissions, tax eligibility, applicant privacy |
| **Tax assignment** | `ALL-181`–`ALL-182` | Per-Alliance bracket; unassigned or invalid = **0%** fallback, never an engine rate |
| **Treaty approval (alliance)** | `ALL-198`, `ALL-207` | The alliance approves the exact version through its lawful process |
| **Treaty coverage (nation)** | `ALL-199`, `ALL-204`, `ALL-207` | Only nations whose owners explicitly consented to the exact version are covered |
| **Attack ban (same Alliance)** | `ALL-209`–`ALL-215` | Applies to any two nations sharing at least one active membership, independently of any treaty |
| **National B-08 treaty** | B-08, `REQ-530` | Unaffected by alliance membership; never overridden by an alliance treaty |

A member is therefore **not** automatically covered by an alliance NAP, and a covered nation is **not** thereby an alliance member. A nation joining an alliance that is party to an active NAP becomes a **non-covered member** unless its owner separately consents (`ALL-204`).

### 2.6 The consent questions

Every workflow answers exactly one of these; none is inferred from another.

| # | Question | Who answers | Silence means | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | May this nation join this alliance? | The applicant's owner submits; the alliance accepts | Application expires; not admission | `ALL-080`–`ALL-084` |
| C2 | May this nation leave? | The member's owner alone | Not applicable; exit is unilateral | `ALL-091`, `REQ-567` |
| C3 | Does this alliance approve this treaty version? | The alliance's lawful process | No approval | `ALL-198` |
| C4 | Is this nation covered by this treaty? | That nation's owner, per version | **Not covered**; remains a member | `ALL-199`, `ALL-204` |
| C5 | May this alliance collect this rate from this member? | No per-policy member consent is required; the member receives notice and a receipt | Tax applies from the frozen snapshot | `ALL-179`, `ALL-186` |
| C6 | May this value leave the donor's nation? | The donor's authenticated confirmation | No donation | `ALL-188`–`ALL-190` |
| C7 | Is this attack permitted? | The server-side validator against current records | Attack is refused if any layer blocks | `ALL-206`–`ALL-215` |

### 2.7 Silence is never consent

No Alliance workflow treats inactivity, a closed window, a missed deadline, an unanswered invitation, an unopposed proposal, membership, a constitution clause, a majority, an alliance office, an AI or an administrator as consent. The only automatic consequences of silence are **expiry** and the **explicit 0% fallback**; both are recorded. A view is not consent. Receiving a notification is not consent.

### 2.8 The deterministic turn snapshot

Every tax-relevant input — active membership, per-Alliance bracket assignment, bracket version and every rate — is read from one immutable snapshot taken when the turn is frozen (`ALL-184`). A change committed **before** the freeze applies to that turn; a change committed **at or after** it applies to the next turn. There is no mid-calculation edit, no recomputation of a completed turn and no retroactive assessment. The snapshot identifier is recorded on every collection and shown to members (`ALL-186`).

Membership changes, treaty coverage changes and attack-ban checks follow the boundary at which they take effect (`ALL-212`); they never apply retroactively.

### 2.9 The attack-validation layers

Every attack path is checked **cumulatively** by one server-side validator at **submission** and again at **execution or settlement** (`ALL-210`–`ALL-213`, `AX-30`). The layers are:

1. **B-03 restricted-pair ban** — a restricted pair cannot attack, join the same side or support each other.
2. **B-08 national treaty/NAP** — an active national NAP blocks the attack.
3. **B-09 same-Alliance ban** — any shared active alliance membership blocks the attack (`ALL-209`).
4. **B-09 Alliance `AT-T01` NAP** — an active covered-nation NAP blocks the attack (`ALL-206`).

Each layer is independent; none waives another. Fail-closed means: no attack, no resource consumption, no readiness or OP consumption, no damage, and a mandatory `AUD-AL-017` record (`ALL-214`, `ALL-215`). A non-covered member is neither protected nor restricted by the NAP layer (`ALL-204`).

### 2.10 Failure semantics

1. **One object, one outcome.** An action either commits its whole effect or writes only the failure line. There is no half-settled tax, half-credited donation, half-paid expense or half-activated treaty.
2. **A failure consumes nothing.** No crowns, resources, readiness, OP, slot or cooldown is consumed by a rejected action (`ALL-215`; `ALF-21`–`ALF-29`).
3. **A failure is not a sanction.** The platform does not fine, freeze, confiscate or retaliate for a refused action.
4. **A retry is a no-op.** The same idempotency key returns the original receipt and applies zero deltas (`ALL-185`, `ALL-192`, `ALL-223`).
5. **A notification failure never rolls back value.** The record stands; the notice retries.
6. **A refusal explains itself.** The player sees the stable code, the rule and, where applicable, the next eligible turn.

### 2.11 What is automatic, and what is never automatic

| Automatic (system acts) | Never automatic (a player or owner must act) |
|---|---|
| Per-turn tax collection at the frozen snapshot (`ALL-179`, `ALL-185`) | Choosing a bracket, rate, assignment or permission (`ALL-181`–`ALL-183`) |
| ARL receipt and category accounting (`ALL-187`) | Donating, authorising an expense, or paying a cost (`ALL-188`, `ALL-222`) |
| Application/invitation expiry at its recorded term (`ALL-084`) | Admitting, rejecting or expelling a member (`ALL-082`) |
| None for constitution publication or activation while `UD-045` is Open; structured activation at `T+1` after verified approval is future conditional and not currently executable (`ALL-035`) | Writing, approving, publishing or activating a constitution (`ALL-031`–`ALL-035`); descriptive authoring only under `UD-045` |
| Treaty expiry at the recorded turn and termination on dissolution (`ALL-205`) | Proposing, approving, consenting, amending or terminating a treaty (`ALL-198`–`ALL-201`) |
| Attack refusal by the validator (`ALL-211`) | Declaring, targeting or ordering an attack |
| Dissolution boundary cleanup once dissolution is lawfully ordered (`ALL-020`) | Ordering dissolution (`ALL-148`) |
| 0% fallback on ambiguous attribution (`ALL-182`, `ALL-185`) | Resolving `UD-040` or inventing a priority (`ALL-185`) |

### 2.12 Vocabulary that must not be used as if a feature exists

The following words may appear **only** with an explicit status qualifier (candidate, unavailable, owner-reserved, prohibited). Using them as if live is a specification defect.

| Word | Correct status today |
|---|---|
| "Treasury", "pool", "balance", "withdraw" | Only the ARL receipt categories exist; general treasury authority is **Open under `UD-046`** (`ALL-226`) |
| "Appeal", "grievance", "hearing", "redress", "reconsideration" | **No right exists.** `UD-044` is owner-reserved; platform moderation is separate (`ALL-142`–`ALL-147`, `REQ-551`) |
| "Delegate", "minister", "proxy", "AI diplomat" | **Zero delegation.** No such actor exists (`REQ-530`, `ALL-125`, `ALL-217`) |
| "Vote", "ballot", "quorum", "majority" | **Candidate only** under `UD-042`/`UD-049`; no ballot exists (`ALL-129`–`ALL-135`) |
| "Bulletin", "announcement board" | **Candidate only** under `UD-049` (`ALL-162`) |
| "Discord sync", "role mirror", "webhook", "OAuth" | **Prohibited.** Zero API connection (`ALL-167`, `D-133`) |
| "Chat", "DM", "typing indicator" | **Prohibited.** Zero real-time chat (`ALL-161`, `D-133`) |
| "Alliance tax rate default" | **None.** Absent or invalid = 0% fallback (`ALL-182`) |
| "Alliance-owned resource" | **None.** ARL establishes no ownership (`ALL-187`, `ALL-226`) |
| "Successor", "heir", "caretaker", "steward", "automatic transfer" | **No approved rule.** A claim is audit evidence only; no office is transferred (`ALL-057`, `UD-043`) |
| "Role permission", "title grants", "permission inherited" | **No general executable permission.** Only the narrow tax-management set is authorized; everything else is proposed or blocked (`ALL-048`, `ALL-067`, `UD-045`) |
| "Contact transfer" meaning an office transfer | **Wrong object.** A contact record is a technical endpoint; no contact record transfers an office or authority (`ALL-015`, `ALL-053`; Test `AAT-112`) |

## 3. Actors, permissions and authority matrix

### 3.1 Actor classes and their lawful reach

| Actor | May | May not |
|---|---|---|
| **Nation owner (non-member)** | Found an alliance (subject to `UD-040` candidate eligibility); apply; view public profiles; view its own records | Read applicants, tax reports, private treaty terms or another nation's data |
| **Applicant** | Withdraw the application; view its own application state | Act as a member; be taxed; be covered by a treaty; vote |
| **Active member** | Leave unilaterally; view public governance, the alliance's descriptive constitution text where recorded, its own receipts and statements, and treaty coverage affecting it | Exercise a capability it does not hold; bind another nation; read restricted records |
| **Capability holder** | Perform exactly the named capability, at execution time, within its precedence (`ALL-062`, `ALL-071`) | Grant a capability it does not hold (`ALL-069`); use a wildcard (`ALL-070`); act after revocation (`ALL-074`) |
| **Primary Administrative Contact** | Receive engine notices; anchor root administrative configuration (`ALL-015`) | Command members; consent for a nation; override a capability check; hold an Alliance office merely because of the contact record; transfer an office or privileged authority through a contact change (`ALL-053`, `ALL-057`, `UD-043`) |
| **Alliance (as an entity)** | Hold a name, identity, record, constitution and receipts | Own national assets; hold sovereign authority; consent for a nation; act without a player |
| **Donor** | Confirm a voluntary transfer from its own nation | Donate reserved value; create debt; direct the ARL to a player |
| **Non-covered member** | Remain a full member; refuse consent without penalty; view the treaty's existence | Be treated as covered; be removed or fined for refusing (`ALL-204`) |
| **Foreign nation** | View public profile fields | View applicants, tax data, consent records or private terms |
| **Platform** | Perform only §2.11 automatic acts | Choose rates, recipients, approvals, consents or outcomes |
| **AI / automation** | Nothing in the Alliance system | Any tax, treasury, treaty, membership, consent or attack decision |
| **Administrator** | Platform moderation and account measures | Found, join, approve, consent, vote, tax, spend, break or attack for a player (`REQ-530`, `ALL-158`) |
| **Prompt 10 validator** | Refuse an attack and write `AUD-AL-017` | Grant coverage, waive a ban or consume value (`ALL-214`, `ALL-215`) |

### 3.2 Capability families

Capability names below are the candidate catalogue (`ALL-066`–`ALL-078`, `UD-045`), except `AUTHORIZE_OPERATIONAL_EXPENDITURE`, which is named by `ALL-222`. The tax-management capabilities are described functionally by `ALL-183`; no uppercase code is fixed for them by B-09, and this document does not invent one. A capability is **never** implied by a title, a rank, a founding act or a majority.

| Family | Capability | What it authorizes | Binding status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Identity | `EDIT_PROFILE` | Public description and metadata | Candidate (`UD-045`) |
| Identity | `MANAGE_CONSTITUTION` | Describe a proposed constitution text | **Candidate; descriptive authoring only**; structured drafting or version creation is not executable under `UD-045` |
| Identity | `PUBLISH_CONSTITUTION` | Claim publication of a version | **Candidate; structured publication is not executable under `UD-045`**; no approval path is active (`ALL-034` is future conditional) |
| Identity | `MANAGE_DISCORD_LINK` | Edit a static URL, if the link ever ships | Candidate (`UD-048`); zero API (`ALL-167`) |
| Membership | `VIEW_APPLICANTS` | Read pending applicant data | Candidate; privacy (`ALL-086`, `ALL-156`) |
| Membership | `ACCEPT_APPLICANTS` | Admit an applicant; extend an invitation | Candidate (`UD-044`) |
| Membership | `REJECT_APPLICANTS` | Decline an application | Candidate (`UD-044`) |
| Membership | `REMOVE_MEMBERS` | Expel, only if expulsion is approved | Candidate (`UD-044`) |
| Governance | `MANAGE_ROLES` | Describe a proposed position | **Candidate; descriptive authoring only**; structured position create/modify/delete/assign is not executable under `UD-045`; anti-escalation (`ALL-062`, `ALL-069`) remains future conditional |
| Governance | `INITIATE_VOTE` / `CLOSE_VOTE` | Open/close a ballot | Candidate (`UD-042`, `UD-049`); no ballot exists |
| Governance | `MANAGE_SUCCESSION` | Configure succession | Candidate (`UD-043`) |
| Treasury | `VIEW_TREASURY` | Read ARL categories and receipts | Candidate; ARL read is not ownership (`ALL-187`) |
| Treasury | `PROPOSE_WITHDRAWAL` / `APPROVE_WITHDRAWAL` / `EXECUTE_WITHDRAWAL` | General withdrawal | **Candidate; no such path exists** (`UD-046`, `ALL-109`–`ALL-116`) |
| Treasury | `MANAGE_CAPACITY` | Pool capacity | **Candidate; no capacity exists** (`UD-046`, `ALL-104`) |
| Treasury | **`AUTHORIZE_OPERATIONAL_EXPENDITURE`** | Allocate/settle a purpose-limited platform cost | **Narrow approved boundary** (`ALL-222`, `D-141`), but **no purpose is spendable today** |
| Tax | Create bracket; edit bracket; delete bracket | Bracket lifecycle | Narrow partial authorization under `UD-045` (`ALL-183`, `ALL-216`) |
| Tax | Set Crowns rate; set resource rate | Per-asset rate `0`–`10,000` bp | Same narrow authorization; no default rate |
| Tax | Assign a nation to a bracket; change assignment | Per-Alliance assignment | Same narrow authorization; 0% fallback applies |
| Tax | View aggregate tax reports; view member contribution history | Read within privacy limits | Same narrow authorization; privacy in §12 and `ALL-186` |
| Announcements | `POST_ANNOUNCEMENT` / `DELETE_ANNOUNCEMENT` | Bulletin | **Candidate only** (`UD-049`) |
| Diplomacy | `MANAGE_FOREIGN_POLICY` | Non-binding internal stance | **Candidate only** (`UD-047`); binds no nation |
| Military | `VIEW_READINESS` | Opt-in aggregate readiness | Candidate (`AX-12`) |
| Military | `COORDINATE_DEFENSE` | Non-binding planning notice | Candidate; no order (`ALL-138`) |
| Military | `MANAGE_COALITIONS` | Metadata declaration | Candidate; no command (`ALL-141`) |

**Executable-versus-proposed rule.** Every row marked **Candidate** is a proposed or descriptive capability only. It is **not executable**, cannot be assigned as an active permission and is blocked under Open `UD-045`. The only executable permission entries today are the four tax-management rows (bracket lifecycle, per-asset rates, per-Alliance assignment and tax reporting) within `D-140`/`DD-164`, plus the narrowly approved `AUTHORIZE_OPERATIONAL_EXPENDITURE` whose purposes remain unavailable because no cost schedule exists. `MANAGE_ROLES`, `MANAGE_CONSTITUTION`, `PUBLISH_CONSTITUTION`, `MANAGE_SUCCESSION`, membership capabilities, treasury capabilities, diplomacy capabilities and military capabilities are **not** general executable powers. A position or title that lists them displays a proposal, not authority.

### 3.3 Consent matrix

| Action | Member's own consent | Alliance approval | Nation-owner consent (per affected nation) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apply | Yes (the applicant submits) | Acceptance by a holder | — | Withdrawal is unilateral (`ALL-081`) |
| Join via invitation | Yes (the invitee accepts) | Invitation by a holder | — | Silence expires; not admission (`ALL-083`) |
| Leave | Yes (unilateral) | None | — | Unblockable (`ALL-091`) |
| Expel | — (candidate) | Candidate procedure | — | **No approved expulsion right or process** (`UD-044`) |
| Dissolve | — | Constitution's own path | — | No universal office (`ALL-148`) |
| Constitution | No per-member consent required | Configured approval evidence | — | Activates `T+1` (`ALL-035`) |
| Tax policy | **No per-policy consent** | Capability holder | — | Notice + receipt (`ALL-179`, `ALL-186`) |
| Donation | Donor's authenticated confirmation | — | — | Irrevocable once settled (`ALL-190`) |
| Operational expense | — | `AUTHORIZE_OPERATIONAL_EXPENDITURE` | — | Pays a platform sink only (`ALL-222`) |
| Alliance treaty | — | Both alliances' lawful approval | **Every covered nation's owner, exact version** | No consent = non-covered (`ALL-199`) |
| NAP coverage | — | Both alliances | **Each covered nation, per version** | Silence never covers (`ALL-207`) |
| Attack | Attacker's order | — | Defender's posture/treaty status | Validator decides (`ALL-211`) |

### 3.4 Sovereign limits that no workflow may cross

1. No Alliance actor can spend, seize or garnish a member's existing national crowns, warehouse stock or city production; the only debits are the production tax and a voluntary donation (`ALL-087`, `ALL-088`, `REQ-176`).
2. No Alliance actor can commit a member's military, declare war for it, or drag it into a war (`ALL-089`, `ALL-136`, `ALL-141`).
3. No Alliance actor can sign, amend, suspend or break a member's B-08 treaty (`ALL-090`, `ALL-122`, `ALL-202`, `REQ-530`).
4. No Alliance actor can block a member from leaving (`ALL-091`, `REQ-567`).
5. No constitution, ballot, majority, AI or administrator can override a global platform rule (`ALL-025`–`ALL-027`, `ALL-050`).
6. No Alliance capability reaches a member's domestic politics, research, construction or policy (`AX-13`, `AX-14`, `ALL-007`).
7. No constitution, title, rank, contact record or position description creates an executable permission. Only a capability expressly authorized by an approved rule may be attached, and only within that rule's exact scope (`ALL-048`, `ALL-064`, `ALL-067`, `UD-045`).
8. No actor may grant a permission beyond the actor's own current authorized set, and no permission is inherited from a predecessor, a title or a contact record (`ALL-062`, `ALL-069`, `ALL-078`).
9. A recorded succession claim, transaction order or contact record never transfers an office, a capability or diplomatic or treasury authority (`ALL-053`, `ALL-057`, `UD-043`).

### 3.5 Execution-time authorization and re-validation

- Every consequential action checks **one named capability at execution time**, server-side, against current records — never against page-load state (`ALL-071`, `REQ-553`).
- A missing capability returns a stable code and changes nothing (`ALF-21` for tax actions; `ALF-27` for operational funding; the applicable refusal for other families).
- A permission mutation is atomic and audited; revoked authority invalidates unexecuted proposals that depended solely on it (`ALL-074`, `ALL-075`).
- Anti-escalation is structural: no actor may grant a capability it does not hold, edit a position at equal or higher precedence, or promote to equal or higher precedence (`ALL-062`, `ALL-069`).
- There is no wildcard and no super-permission (`ALL-070`).
- **Executable authority today is limited to the narrow tax-management set** authorized by `D-140`/`DD-164`: bracket creation/editing, Crowns and resource rate configuration, member bracket assignment/reassignment, and the relevant tax-reporting access (`ALL-183`, `ALL-216`). Every other general permission assignment, inheritance, delegation, role-based power or authority transfer is **blocked or unavailable** under Open `UD-045`; a proposal may be recorded only as descriptive content, and it is neither active nor executable.
- A stale, cached or revoked permission never bypasses the execution-time check. Revocation invalidates unexecuted proposals that depended solely on it (`ALL-074`).
- An unauthorized attempt returns a stable refusal and changes no state; a role title is never accepted as evidence of permission.

### 3.6 System actors are not authorities

The platform may compute, freeze, collect, credit, expire, validate and record. It may not choose. Where a workflow says "the system does X automatically", X is one of §2.11's acts and nothing more.

## 4. Lifecycle and state-transition models

### 4.1 Alliance lifecycle

| State | Meaning | Entered by | Exits |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ACTIVE` | Operational; roster, governance, receipts and (where approved) operational funding | Atomic founding (`ALL-012`) | Lawful dissolution (`ALL-148`) |
| `DISSOLVED` | Roster released; pending objects terminated; records archived | Dissolution boundary (`ALL-020`) | None; permanent archive (`ALL-152`) |

There is no `FOUNDING`, `SUSPENDED`, `MERGED` or `INACTIVE` state. An abandoned-alliance review is **candidate** (`ALL-150`, `UD-043`) and does not create a lifecycle state.

### 4.2 Membership and application

```text
(none) --apply--> PENDING --accept--> ACCEPTED  => ACTIVE_MEMBER
                     |--reject-----> REJECTED
                     |--withdraw---> WITHDRAWN
                     |--expiry-----> EXPIRED
ACTIVE_MEMBER --leave / removal(candidate) / dissolution--> FORMER_MEMBER
```

| Transition | Trigger | Automatic? | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| None → `PENDING` | Applicant submits | No | `ALL-080` |
| `PENDING` → `ACCEPTED` | Holder of `ACCEPT_APPLICANTS` accepts; atomic membership creation | No | `ALL-082`, `REQ-565` |
| `PENDING` → `REJECTED` | Holder of `REJECT_APPLICANTS` rejects | No | `ALL-082` |
| `PENDING` → `WITHDRAWN` | Applicant withdraws | No | `ALL-081` |
| `PENDING` → `EXPIRED` | Recorded term elapses (candidate) | Yes | `ALL-084` |
| `ACTIVE_MEMBER` → `FORMER_MEMBER` | Voluntary leave | No | `ALL-091` |
| `ACTIVE_MEMBER` → `FORMER_MEMBER` | Expulsion, only if approved | No | `ALL-142`–`ALL-145`, `UD-044` |
| `ACTIVE_MEMBER` → `FORMER_MEMBER` | Dissolution | Yes at the boundary | `ALL-020`, `ALL-021` |

Invariants: at most one live application per nation (`REQ-564`); acceptance is one atomic act (`REQ-565`); a nation's membership in at most one alliance is a **candidate** baseline (`ALL-019`, `UD-040`), not an invariant; no state grants tax responsibility outside `ACTIVE_MEMBER`.

### 4.3 Constitution versions

**Authority status.** No structured constitution version is currently executable or creatable. The states and transitions below are the future conditional model defined by `ALL-031`–`ALL-043`. While `UD-045` is Open, `ALW-008`/`ALW-009` author descriptive, non-operative text only; every structured draft, approval, publication, activation or supersession attempt is refused (`ALF-08`), and no version exists to be `ACTIVE` or `PUBLISHED`.

| State | Meaning | Transition |
|---|---|---|
| `DRAFT` | Private working version | Submitted → `PENDING_APPROVAL`; withdrawn → `WITHDRAWN` |
| `PENDING_APPROVAL` | Hash and diff generated; approval evidence collected | Verified → `PUBLISHED`; rejected/withdrawn → archived |
| `PUBLISHED` / `ACTIVE` | In force from the next boundary | Superseded by the next version |
| `SUPERSEDED` | Read-only prior version | Terminal |
| `WITHDRAWN` | Draft abandoned | Terminal |

Exactly one version is `ACTIVE` at a time (`ALL-041`). Publication marks the prior version `SUPERSEDED` atomically. Activation is `T+1` (`ALL-035`). No retroactivity (`ALL-028`). Prose is never parsed into mechanics (`ALL-026`). These transitions are unreachable while `UD-045` is Open.

### 4.4 Tax bracket versions

| State | Meaning | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `DRAFT` | Named object; every rate starts at 0% | No assessment |
| `ACTIVE` (version `v`) | Assigned to at least one member; rates `0`–`10,000` bp | Applies from the snapshot in which it is the frozen version |
| `SUPERSEDED` | Replaced by a later version | No new assessment; historical receipts retain the old version |
| `DELETED` | Removed by an authorized actor | Any member still pointing at it falls to **0%** fallback until reassigned |

A rate change creates a new version or updates the bracket under the alliance's own policy; either way, the frozen snapshot decides the turn (`ALL-184`). An unassigned member, an invalid bracket or a missing rate is **0%**, explicitly recorded (`ALL-182`).

### 4.5 Donation lifecycle

```text
SELECTED -> CONFIRMED -> SETTLED (receipt)   [terminal]
     |           |
     +-> CANCELLED (before confirmation)
                 +-> FAILED (ALF-24; nothing moved)
```

A settled donation is irrevocable (`ALL-190`). A retry with the same key returns the receipt and moves nothing (`ALL-192`). There is no refund, reversal or donor claim (`ALL-195`).

### 4.6 ARL accounting transitions

| Event | `RECEIVED` | `AVAILABLE` | `RESERVED` | `EXPENDED` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tax receipt | `+X` | `+X` | — | — |
| Donation receipt | `+X` | `+X` | — | — |
| Valid authorization | — | `−X` | `+X` | — |
| Settlement | — | — | `−X` | `+X` |
| Release / failure | — | `+X` | `−X` | — |
| Rejection | — | — | — | — |

The invariant holds after every step. `RESERVED` and `EXPENDED` can never be spent again. No capacity rejection exists (`ALL-225`).

### 4.7 Operational authorization lifecycle

| State | Meaning | Transition |
|---|---|---|
| `DRAFT` | Being prepared; no effect | Submitted → `VALIDATED` or `REJECTED` |
| `VALIDATED` | Purpose registered, schedule active, amount exact, sink correct, permission held, sufficient `AVAILABLE` | Reserve → `RESERVED`; or reject `ALF-27` |
| `RESERVED` | `AVAILABLE → RESERVED`; pays nobody | Settle → `SETTLED`; release → `RELEASED` |
| `SETTLED` | `RESERVED → EXPENDED`; platform cost posted; receipt and `AUD-AL-019` | Terminal |
| `RELEASED` | Reservation returned to `AVAILABLE` | Terminal |
| `REJECTED` | Nothing moved | Terminal |

**Today every valid attempt terminates at `REJECTED` with `ALF-27`** because no `AOP-01`–`AOP-04` cost schedule is approved. `RESERVED` and `SETTLED` are specified but unreachable in the current specification state.

### 4.8 Alliance treaty lifecycle

| State | Meaning | Transition |
|---|---|---|
| `DRAFT` | Terms prepared by an authorized alliance actor | Submitted → `PROPOSED` |
| `PROPOSED` | Sent to the counterparty alliance | Counterparty approves → `APPROVED_BY_BOTH`; reject/withdraw → terminal |
| `APPROVED_BY_BOTH` | Both alliances approved the exact version | Consent collection → `CONSENT_PENDING` |
| `CONSENT_PENDING` | Covered nations' owners decide | Complete set → `PENDING_ACTIVATION`; incomplete → remains pending or lapses |
| `PENDING_ACTIVATION` | Valid, awaiting the boundary | Boundary → `ACTIVE` |
| `ACTIVE` | Effect applies per the registered effect | Amend → new version; terminate/breach → terminal; expiry → `EXPIRED` |
| `AMENDED` | New version in force; prior version superseded | — |
| `TERMINATED` | Mutual termination; no breach | Terminal |
| `BREACHED` | Unilateral breach; public record | Terminal |
| `EXPIRED` | Recorded term elapsed | Terminal |
| `ENDED_BY_DISSOLUTION` | A party dissolved; treaty ends whole | Terminal |

`AT-E00` treaties can be `ACTIVE` as records and execute nothing. `AT-E01` can be selected **only** by `AT-T01` and is the only executable effect (`ALL-197`, `ALL-203`). No treaty activates with an empty, inferred or incomplete consent set for `AT-E01` (`ALL-207`).

### 4.9 NAP coverage set

The covered set is exactly the recorded consenting nations per side (`ALL-204`, `ALL-207`). It changes only by:

- a new consent recorded before activation;
- an amendment requiring fresh consent (`ALL-201`);
- a nation joining or leaving an alliance — **no automatic extension**; a joiner is non-covered until it consents (`ALL-204`);
- expiry, termination, breach or dissolution — the effect ends whole (`ALL-205`).

A non-covered member is neither protected nor restricted by that NAP. Declining consent never affects membership, admission or standing (`ALL-199`, `ALL-204`).

### 4.10 Attack-validation decision

| Checkpoint | Input | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| **Submission** | Attacker, defender, attack type, current memberships, active treaties | `ALLOWED` (continue) or `BLOCKED` (refuse; `ALF-26`; `AUD-AL-017`) |
| **Execution / settlement** | Same inputs re-read; membership may have changed | `ALLOWED` or `BLOCKED`; the execution check governs (`ALL-211`) |
| **Post-block** | — | No consumption, no damage, no retaliation; explanation to the attacker (`ALL-214`, `ALL-215`) |

A blocked attempt is not retried automatically. A later attempt is a new request and is revalidated.

### 4.11 Succession and vacancy (unresolved, record-only)

No succession, election, caretaker, heir, steward or fixed inactivity threshold is approved (`UD-043`). The model is **record-only**:

1. A succession, leadership or stewardship claim may be recorded as immutable evidence with its actor, turn and timestamp exactly as `ALL-057` permits. A recorded claim is **not** a decision.
2. Recording a claim, transaction order, timestamp order or completion of any technical step **does not** assign or transfer an office, recognise a successor or steward, or establish political authority (`ALL-057`).
3. Constitution text may describe a desired succession path, but the engine does not execute that path. The exact transfer workflow and eligibility rules remain candidate under `UD-043` (`ALL-053`, `ALL-054`).
4. The system does not appoint an heir or replacement automatically, does not infer authority from inactivity, and does not create a caretaker with Alliance decision-making powers. `D-028`'s 168-turn account dormancy is an account rule and is **not** an Alliance succession rule.
5. A vacancy or succession dispute is represented as `VACANT` or `UNRESOLVED` in the record. It is not filled by the engine.
6. Any privileged operation that requires the missing office or authority is **blocked or unavailable** while the policy remains unresolved, and the refusal explains that the succession policy is unresolved.
7. The audit history retains every claim and every refusal as evidence. It never treats a recorded claim as a successful transfer.

**What "record-only" means for every dependent object.** The contact pointer, office record, position assignment, capability set, diplomatic authority and treasury authority are separate objects. Writing a claim record never writes any of them. This separation is tested by `AAT-111`–`AAT-118`.

### 4.12 Transition invariants

| Invariant | Statement |
|---|---|
| **Atomicity** | Every transition commits whole or not at all |
| **Idempotency** | Same key ⇒ same outcome, zero new effect |
| **Non-retroactivity** | No transition rewrites a completed turn or a historical record |
| **One active version** | Exactly one constitution version and one applicable bracket version per member per Alliance at a snapshot |
| **One application** | At most one live application per nation (`REQ-564`) |
| **One membership row** | One row per nation per alliance (`REQ-566`) |
| **No implied coverage** | Membership never creates treaty coverage |
| **No implied authority** | Membership or title never creates a capability |
| **No implied succession** | A recorded claim, timestamp, transaction order, completed technical step or contact-record change never creates, fills or transfers an office (`ALL-057`, `UD-043`) |
| **Contact is not office** | The Primary Administrative Contact is a technical endpoint; the contact pointer and any office or capability record are separate objects (`ALL-015`, `ALL-051`) |
| **No hidden value** | Every ARL change reconciles to a receipt, authorization, settlement, release or rejection |
| **No debt** | No state permits a negative national or ARL balance |

## 5. Workflow catalogue (groups A–J)

Each workflow has the same 18 fields. Field 8 is what the player sees **before** confirming; field 11 is what the engine does; field 16 names every lawful refusal; field 18 is the traceability spine. Notification labels `AN-01`–`AN-16` are **internal to this companion** (§12) and are not game identifiers. A workflow never creates a rule; where a field depends on an open decision it says so.

### Group A — Founding and membership

#### ALW-001 — Found an alliance

| # | Field | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **ID / name** | `ALW-001` — Found an alliance |
| 2 | **Purpose** | Create a persistent alliance identity and its bootstrap governance container in one atomic act |
| 3 | **Initiating actor** | Authenticated owner of an active nation |
| 4 | **Permissions** | None beyond nation ownership (`ALL-011`); founding creates no office and no capability |
| 5 | **Preconditions** | Actor owns an active nation; identity is not banned; name and tag pass uniqueness and moderation; **candidate only:** unaffiliated, no active founding/rejoin cooldown, sufficient crowns for a fee (`ALL-011`, `UD-040`) — none of these candidate conditions is enforced today |
| 6 | **Inputs** | Name; tag; optional description; confirmation |
| 7 | **Validation** | Ownership; name/tag normalised uniqueness across active and dissolved identities; moderation; if a fee is ever approved, sufficient unreserved crowns; all checks repeated server-side at execution |
| 8 | **Player-visible information** | That founding creates **no** authority over any other nation; the exact fee status ("no fee is approved" or the approved amount); that no office is created; that the founder becomes Primary Administrative Contact as a technical endpoint, not a "Leader"; what can be edited later |
| 9 | **Decision points** | Whether to found; name; tag; description |
| 10 | **Consent requirements** | The founder's own authenticated confirmation. No other nation consents |
| 11 | **System processing** | One atomic transaction at a boundary: optional approved fee debit; create `ACTIVE` alliance; create founder membership; assign Primary Administrative Contact; create bootstrap governance container; write `AUD-AL-001` (`ALL-012`) |
| 12 | **State transitions** | None → `ACTIVE` |
| 13 | **Resource consequences** | **None today.** If `UD-040` later approves a fee, `F-AL-002` would debit it atomically and sink it; no refund on dissolution or transfer (`ALL-016`) |
| 14 | **Notifications** | `AN-04` to the founder (confirmation). No public announcement is created (`UD-049`) |
| 15 | **Audit / history** | `AUD-AL-001` with founder, identity, turn, fee-if-any and contact assignment |
| 16 | **Failure** | `ALF-01` name/tag collision; `ALF-05` insufficient fee **only if a fee is approved**; account-ineligible refusal; any failure debits nothing and creates nothing |
| 17 | **Cancellation / recovery** | Cancel before confirmation changes nothing. After commit, only lawful dissolution ends the alliance (`ALW-007`). A failed attempt may be retried with a new idempotency key |
| 18 | **Rules · requirements · formulas · tests** | `ALL-011`–`ALL-017`; `REQ-534`–`REQ-537`; `F-AL-002` (candidate); `AX-01`; `AAT-001`, `AAT-002` |

#### ALW-002 — Apply to an alliance (and withdraw)

| # | Field | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **ID / name** | `ALW-002` — Apply to an alliance; withdraw a pending application |
| 2 | **Purpose** | Let a nation request membership and let it revoke that request freely before a decision |
| 3 | **Initiating actor** | The applicant nation's owner |
| 4 | **Permissions** | Own nation only; no delegation (`REQ-530`) |
| 5 | **Preconditions** | Applicant is an active nation; no other live application exists (`REQ-564`); alliance is `ACTIVE` and (if configured) recruiting; **candidate only:** single-alliance and cooldown checks (`ALL-019`, `F-AL-004`, `UD-040`/`UD-044`) |
| 6 | **Inputs** | Alliance identity; optional pitch text (candidate cap 1,000 characters); confirmation. Withdrawal: application identifier; optional reason |
| 7 | **Validation** | Ownership; alliance active; no live application; text moderation; server re-validation at submission |
| 8 | **Player-visible information** | That the application is voluntary; that the applicant can withdraw at any time without penalty; that no membership, tax liability, treaty coverage or permission begins until acceptance; the candidate expiry ("expires after 36 turns **if that provisional value is adopted**") |
| 9 | **Decision points** | Which alliance; whether to include a pitch; whether to withdraw |
| 10 | **Consent requirements** | The applicant's own. The alliance's acceptance comes later (`ALW-003`) |
| 11 | **System processing** | Create one `PENDING` application with nation, turn, pitch and status; withdraw sets `WITHDRAWN` and releases the live-application slot; expiry sets `EXPIRED` at the recorded term |
| 12 | **State transitions** | None → `PENDING` → `WITHDRAWN` / `EXPIRED` (acceptance/rejection in `ALW-003`) |
| 13 | **Resource consequences** | None |
| 14 | **Notifications** | `AN-01` to holders of `VIEW_APPLICANTS`; `AN-02` only to the applicant on withdrawal |
| 15 | **Audit / history** | Application record (private); withdrawal line; no public event |
| 16 | **Failure** | Duplicate live application; inactive alliance; invalid/blocked text; candidate single-alliance or cooldown refusal **only if approved** |
| 17 | **Cancellation / recovery** | Withdrawal is always available while `PENDING` and creates no cooldown. After a rejection the nation may apply again (no approved cooldown) |
| 18 | **Rules · requirements · formulas · tests** | `ALL-079`–`ALL-081`, `ALL-084`, `ALL-086`; `REQ-562`–`REQ-564`; `F-AL-004` (candidate); `AX-09`, `AX-10`; `AAT-005`, `AAT-006` |

#### ALW-003 — Review a pending application

| # | Field | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **ID / name** | `ALW-003` — Accept or reject a pending application |
| 2 | **Purpose** | Decide an application atomically and tell the applicant the outcome |
| 3 | **Initiating actor** | A member holding `ACCEPT_APPLICANTS` or `REJECT_APPLICANTS` |
| 4 | **Permissions** | The matching capability, checked at execution; precedence rules apply |
| 5 | **Preconditions** | Application `PENDING`; alliance `ACTIVE`; actor still holds the capability; applicant still eligible; **candidate:** roster capacity and single-alliance checks (`ALL-085`, `UD-044`/`UD-040`) |
| 6 | **Inputs** | Application identifier; decision; optional internal note (not shown to the applicant unless the alliance chooses to publish it) |
| 7 | **Validation** | Capability; application state; applicant identity and availability; atomic re-check of every precondition; no partial membership |
| 8 | **Player-visible information** | Applicant identity and pitch (private to administration); that acceptance creates membership, assigns the configured default member position (a baseline membership position that grants no capability and is not a general position-management operation) and starts tenure; that rejection is final for this application and creates no approved cooldown; that no national asset or treaty is affected |
| 9 | **Decision points** | Accept or reject; which default member position applies |
| 10 | **Consent requirements** | The applicant's submission is its consent to be considered; acceptance is the alliance's decision, not the applicant's consent to any tax or treaty |
| 11 | **System processing** | Acceptance: one atomic act creates `ACTIVE_MEMBER`, assigns the configured default member position (baseline membership only; no capability and no general position-management operation), starts tenure, closes the application (`REQ-565`). Rejection: closes the application and notifies the applicant |
| 12 | **State transitions** | `PENDING` → `ACCEPTED` (membership `ACTIVE_MEMBER`); `PENDING` → `REJECTED` |
| 13 | **Resource consequences** | None. Membership alone creates no tax, no donation and no treasury claim |
| 14 | **Notifications** | `AN-02` to the applicant; `AN-04` to the new member and officers on acceptance |
| 15 | **Audit / history** | Decision record with actor, turn, application and reason code; membership creation record |
| 16 | **Failure** | Missing capability; stale state; applicant unavailable; candidate roster/single-alliance refusal if approved; any failure leaves the application `PENDING` |
| 17 | **Cancellation / recovery** | A failed acceptance may be retried after the cause is fixed. A rejection cannot be undone; the applicant may reapply freely |
| 18 | **Rules · requirements · formulas · tests** | `ALL-079`, `ALL-082`, `ALL-085`, `ALL-086`; `REQ-562`, `REQ-565`, `REQ-566`; `AX-09`, `AX-10`; `AAT-007`–`AAT-009` |

#### ALW-004 — Extend a direct invitation (candidate)

| # | Field | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **ID / name** | `ALW-004` — Extend a direct recruitment invitation |
| 2 | **Purpose** | Let an authorized officer invite an unaffiliated nation, which may accept or decline freely |
| 3 | **Initiating actor** | A member holding `ACCEPT_APPLICANTS` |
| 4 | **Permissions** | `ACCEPT_APPLICANTS` at execution |
| 5 | **Preconditions** | Alliance `ACTIVE`; invitee is an active, unaffiliated nation; no live invitation or application between them; candidate expiry 24 turns (`ALL-083`, provisional) |
| 6 | **Inputs** | Invitee nation; optional message (moderated); confirmation |
| 7 | **Validation** | Capability; invitee availability; duplicate check; moderation; no self-invitation |
| 8 | **Player-visible information** | That the invitation is **not** admission; that the invitee may decline without penalty; that acceptance creates membership only (no tax consent, no treaty coverage); the expiry term and its provisional status |

### Group B — Constitution and governance

**Binding authority boundary for the whole group (`UD-045` Open).** Every workflow in this group distinguishes four things that must never be collapsed:

1. **Constitutional description** — an Alliance may describe offices, ranks, duties and governance arrangements in its player-authored text. Description creates no engine permission (`ALL-024`, `ALL-048`, `D-135`).
2. **Proposed configuration** — a position or capability set may be recorded as a proposal where existing rules permit. A proposal is not active, cannot execute and grants nothing.
3. **Narrow tax-management configuration** — only the exact capabilities authorized by `D-140`/`DD-164` may be attached and executed: bracket creation/editing, Crowns and resource rate configuration, member bracket assignment/reassignment, and relevant tax-reporting access (`ALL-183`, `ALL-216`).
4. **General Alliance permissions** — every other capability assignment, inheritance, delegation, authority transfer or role-based power is **blocked or unavailable** under Open `UD-045`. Nothing in this group may activate it, and a title, rank, founding act or constitution clause is never evidence of it.

Every consequential action below still requires a server-side authentication and authorization check at execution time (`ALL-071`). A refused action changes no state and explains the boundary.

| 16 | **Failure** | Any attempt to make the record executable, to appoint an heir or caretaker, to infer authority from inactivity or to treat a completed technical step as a transfer is rejected; nothing changes |
| 17 | **Cancellation / recovery** | Another claim may be recorded alongside the first; the dispute remains `UNRESOLVED`; the engine does not choose between claims |
| 18 | **Rules · requirements · formulas · tests** | `ALL-051`–`ALL-058`; `REQ-548`, `REQ-549`; `AX-03`, `AX-04`; `F-AL-003` (candidate); `UD-043`; `AAT-034`, `AAT-111`–`AAT-118` |

**Boundary statement.** `ALL-057` makes a competing claim admissible as evidence and nothing more. The record may show that a claim exists; it may not show that the claimant won. The only lawful outcomes of `ALW-013` are `VACANT`, `CLAIMED` or `UNRESOLVED` records plus audit evidence. A privileged operation that depends on the vacant office is refused with an explanation that the succession policy is unresolved.

| 9 | **Decision points** | Platform moderation only |
| 10 | **Consent requirements** | None |
| 11 | **System processing** | Keep the two records separate; no automatic removal from alliance on moderation action |
| 12 | **State transitions** | None in alliance membership |
| 13 | **Resource consequences** | None |
| 14 | **Notifications** | `AN-16` where a platform action affects a player's alliance-visible status, without disclosing moderation detail beyond policy |
| 15 | **Audit / history** | Platform moderation audit; alliance audit only for actual membership changes |
| 16 | **Failure** | An attempt to use alliance authority as moderation is refused |
| 17 | **Cancellation / recovery** | Follows the platform evidence-and-appeal path, not an alliance appeal (`UD-044` preserved) |
| 18 | **Rules · requirements · formulas · tests** | `ALL-142`, `ALL-146`, `ALL-158`; `REQ-025`, `REQ-026`; `AX-23`; `AAT-103`, `AAT-105` |

## 6. Workflow-to-state transition ledger

Every workflow in §5 is a gate on a named state change. This ledger is the implementation-facing list: if a transition is not here, no workflow may perform it. `R` means the transition is reversible only by a new forward event, never by rewriting the prior record.

### 6.1 Founding, membership and lifecycle

| Workflow | From → To | Guard | Audit | R |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALW-001` | none → `ACTIVE` alliance | eligible founder; unique name/tag; atomic six-step founding | `AUD-AL-001` | No |
| `ALW-002` | none → `APPLICANT`/`PENDING` | eligible unaffiliated nation; application record complete | membership record | Yes (withdraw) |
| `ALW-002` | `PENDING` → `WITHDRAWN` | applicant's own act | membership record | No |
| `ALW-003` | `PENDING` → `ACTIVE_MEMBER` | active accept capability; no self-approval; atomic assign baseline default position (no capability) | `AUD-AL-003` | No |
| `ALW-003` | `PENDING` → `REJECTED` | active reject capability | membership record | No |
| `ALW-004` | `INVITED` → `ACTIVE_MEMBER` | invitee's own acceptance | `AUD-AL-003` | No |
| `ALW-005` | `ACTIVE_MEMBER` → `FORMER_MEMBER` | the member's own unblockable act | `AUD-AL-002` | No (fresh rejoin only) |
| `ALW-006` | `ACTIVE_MEMBER` → `FORMER_MEMBER` | **only if** an expulsion mechanism is approved under `UD-044`; higher precedence; `REMOVE_MEMBERS` | `AUD-AL-010` | No |
| `ALW-007` | `ACTIVE` → `DISSOLVED` | constitution-defined authority; confirmation | `AUD-AL-011` | No |

## 7. Cross-lifecycle matrices

### 7.1 Membership state × action legality

| Action | `APPLICANT` | `ACTIVE_MEMBER` | `FORMER_MEMBER` | Non-member |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apply | No (already pending) | No | Yes, if eligible and no cooldown applies | Yes |
| Withdraw application | Yes | No | No | No |
| Accept / reject | No | No | No | No (no application) |
| Leave | No (withdraw first) | Yes, unblockable | No | No |
| Be removed | No | Only if expulsion approved (`UD-044`) | No | No |
| Be taxed | No | Yes, current-turn production only | No | No |
| Donate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Consent to treaty coverage | No (coverage needs membership) | Yes, own nation only | No | No |
| Be covered by NAP | No | Only by own explicit consent | No | No |
| View member-only records | No | Per visibility class | Archived public record only | Public record only |
| Hold a position | No | Yes | No | No |

### 7.2 Treaty status × action legality

| Action | `PROPOSED` | `APPROVED_BY_ONE` | `APPROVED_BY_BOTH` | `ACTIVE` | `EXPIRED`/`TERMINATED`/`BREACHED` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Approve | Yes, by the pending Alliance | Yes, by the other | No | No | No |
| Consent | No (not yet binding) | No | Yes | No (new version only) | No |
| Activate | No | No | Yes, if consents complete | No | No |
| Amend | Yes (new proposal) | Yes (new proposal) | Yes, new version | Yes, new version | No |
| Terminate | Yes (withdraw) | Yes (withdraw) | Yes | Yes (mutual) | No |
| Breach declare | No | No | No | Yes | No |
| Execute mechanic | No | No | No | Only `AT-E01` on `AT-T01` | No |
| Attack check reads it | No | No | No | Yes, if `AT-E01` active | No |

### 7.3 ARL category × event

| Event | `RECEIVED` | `AVAILABLE` | `RESERVED` | `EXPENDED` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tax receipt | +amount | +amount | — | — |
| Donation receipt | +amount | +amount | — | — |
| Authorise operational expense | — | −amount | +amount | — |
| Settle operational expense | — | — | −amount | +amount |
| Release reservation | — | +amount | −amount | — |
| Failed settlement | — | +amount (restored) | −amount (restored) | — |
| Player distribution / general withdrawal | **prohibited** | **prohibited** | **prohibited** | **prohibited** |

The invariant `AVAILABLE = RECEIVED − RESERVED − EXPENDED` is checked after every event; a violation blocks the event and is disclosed, never netted.

### 7.4 Authorization matrix at execution time

| Capability family | Member | Position holder | Primary Administrative Contact | Alliance owner-as-nation | Platform |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Membership accept/reject | No | Only with the named capability | No implicit power | No | No |
| Constitution publish | No | No; structured publication is blocked under `UD-045` | No implicit power | No | No |
| Position/permission change | No | No; structured change is blocked under `UD-045` and candidate `MANAGE_ROLES` is not executable | No implicit power | No | No |
| Tax bracket/rate/assignment | No | Only with the named tax capability | No implicit power | No | No |
| Donate own value | Own nation only | Own nation only | Own nation only | Own nation only | No |
| Operational expenditure | No | Only with `AUTHORIZE_OPERATIONAL_EXPENDITURE` | No implicit power | No | No |
| Treaty proposal/approval | No | Only with the constitution-assigned capability | No implicit power | No | No |
| Nation treaty consent | Own nation only | Own nation only | Own nation only | Own nation only | No |
| Attack | Own nation only | Own nation only | Own nation only | Own nation only | No |
| Suspend an account | No | No | No | No | Platform moderation only |

No row has a wildcard; no row lets an Alliance office act for a nation; no row makes a technical contact a political ruler.

### 7.5 Turn-boundary matrix

| Change | Committed before freeze | Committed after freeze |
|---|---|---|
| Membership join/leave | Applies to this settlement | Applies to the next settlement |
| Bracket/rate/assignment | Applies to this settlement | Applies to the next settlement |
| Treaty activation/expiry | Checked at the boundary it records | No retroactive effect |
| Attack validation | Uses current records at submission and again at execution | Uses current records at execution |
| Operational authorisation | May reserve for a future settlement | Cannot alter a completed settlement |

## 8. Player journeys

Each journey is a narrative acceptance path. The steps name the workflow that owns the state change, the expected player experience and what must not happen. Journeys are not additional rules; where a step depends on an Open decision it is marked.

### J1 — Found an Alliance and become the technical contact

- **Actor / goal:** A nation owner wants a named Alliance with a working contact channel.
- **Preconditions:** The founder meets the candidate eligibility gate (`ALL-011`, `ALF-01`); the name and tag are unique; no fee is approved.
- **Steps:** Choose name and tag → accept the fixed safety rules → found atomically (`ALW-001`) → receive the `ACTIVE` Alliance and the Primary Administrative Contact technical endpoint.
- **Expected:** The founder sees the Alliance as `ACTIVE`, is the technical contact, holds no automatic political power, and no member is taxed yet.
- **Prohibited:** A mandatory Leader title; an automatic tax; a founding fee presented as existing; a second founder bypassing uniqueness.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-001`, `AAT-002`.

### J2 — Apply, get accepted and become an ordinary member

- **Actor / goal:** An unaffiliated nation owner wants to join.
- **Preconditions:** No active membership; Alliance `ACTIVE`; application text within 1,000 characters.
- **Steps:** Submit application (`ALW-002`) → officer reviews (`ALW-003`) → acceptance atomically assigns the default position and starts tenure.
- **Expected:** Status `ACTIVE_MEMBER`; the member sees the alliance's descriptive constitution text where recorded (no published version exists while `UD-045` is Open) and effective tax policy; the member is taxed only from the next eligible settlement.
- **Prohibited:** Self-approval; acceptance without the capability; a retroactive charge for the application turn.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-005`, `AAT-007`.

### J3 — Application rejected or withdrawn

- **Actor / goal:** An applicant wants a clean, penalty-free outcome.
- **Preconditions:** `PENDING` application.
- **Steps:** Either the applicant withdraws (`ALW-002`) or an officer rejects (`ALW-003`).
- **Expected:** `WITHDRAWN`/`REJECTED`; no fee; no candidate cooldown is applied as if it were a rule.
- **Prohibited:** A rejection that secretly blocks future applications beyond an approved rule; disclosure of the application to ordinary members.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-006`, `AAT-008`.

### J4 — Ordinary member experiences the automatic production tax

- **Actor / goal:** A member wants to understand exactly what was deducted.
- **Preconditions:** Active membership; one active bracket assignment; a rate above 0%.
- **Steps:** Play the turn → settlement withholds at source (`ALW-018`) → open the per-turn statement (`ALW-019`).
- **Expected:** Tax is a percentage of the turn's gross production only; the statement reconciles gross, tax and net; the ARL `RECEIVED`/`AVAILABLE` rose by the same amount.
- **Prohibited:** A charge on an existing stockpile or opening balance; a double deduction across two production events; a per-event rounding that exceeds the cumulative due.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-045`–`AAT-049`.

### J5 — Alliance sets a 100% bracket

- **Actor / goal:** A policy role wants all current-turn production withheld.
- **Preconditions:** Tax capability; bracket assignment; rate 10,000 bp.
- **Steps:** Set the Crowns and per-resource rates to 10,000 (`ALW-015`) → settle (`ALW-020`).
- **Expected:** Net retention is exactly zero for taxed assets; the member statement shows the full amount moved to the ARL; the nation is not put into debt.
- **Prohibited:** Charging maintenance from a negative balance; borrowing from the next turn; confiscating stockpiles.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-049`, `AAT-055`.

### J6 — Member makes a voluntary donation

- **Actor / goal:** A nation owner wants to contribute once, deliberately.
- **Preconditions:** Supported asset; sufficient unreserved value; `ACTIVE` Alliance.
- **Steps:** Choose alliance, asset and exact amount → read the irrevocability notice → confirm (`ALW-021`) → receive the receipt.
- **Expected:** One atomic transfer; donor debit equals ARL credit; receipt shows `transfer_id`; repeating the same confirmation returns the original receipt.
- **Prohibited:** A recurring debit; a fee or cap presented as existing; crediting a different Alliance; a second debit on retry.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-057`–`AAT-060`.

### J7 — Treasurer-type role reviews the ARL

- **Actor / goal:** An authorised role wants to know what the Alliance actually holds.
- **Preconditions:** The role holds the applicable view capability; receipts exist.
- **Steps:** Open the ARL view (`ALW-023`) → inspect per-asset categories and reconciliation.
- **Expected:** `RECEIVED`, `AVAILABLE`, `RESERVED`, `EXPENDED` and the invariant are visible; the view states that no purpose is currently spendable.
- **Prohibited:** A "withdraw" button; an implied ownership of the value; hiding reserved amounts.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-063`.

### J8 — Authorised role tries to pay an operational cost

- **Actor / goal:** A role wants to pay the Alliance registration fee from the ARL.
- **Preconditions:** `AUTHORIZE_OPERATIONAL_EXPENDITURE` held; ARL has `AVAILABLE` value; **no cost schedule is approved**.
- **Steps:** Choose `AOP-01` → enter amount → submit (`ALW-024`).
- **Expected:** Refused with a clear explanation that the purpose is registered but unavailable because no cost schedule exists; nothing reserved or paid.
- **Prohibited:** A partial payment; a guessed amount; a payment to a player; an "administrator override".
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-064`, `AAT-065`.

### J9 — Two Alliances sign a record-only cooperation pact

- **Actor / goal:** Two Alliances want a visible, non-binding diplomatic record.
- **Preconditions:** Both `ACTIVE`; type `AT-T03` or `AT-T04`; effect `AT-E00`.
- **Steps:** Propose (`ALW-027`) → both approve (`ALW-028`) → activate (`ALW-030`) → members view it (`ALW-034`).
- **Expected:** The record is stored and displayed; no consent is required because it binds nobody; no mechanic executes; the attack validator ignores it.
- **Prohibited:** A trade channel; a tariff; a troop obligation; a hidden attack ban inferred from prose.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-073`, `AAT-074`.

### J10 — Two Alliances form a full-coverage NAP

- **Actor / goal:** Both Alliances want a working non-aggression pact.
- **Preconditions:** Type `AT-T01`; effect `AT-E01`; both approvals; every named owner consents.
- **Steps:** Propose → approve → each affected owner consents (`ALW-029`) → activate (`ALW-030`) → coverage view (`ALW-035`).
- **Expected:** Only explicitly consenting nations are covered; attacks between covered nations are blocked at submission and execution; the covered set is visible.
- **Prohibited:** Coverage inferred from membership; activation with one missing consent; a waiver by a leader.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-077`, `AAT-081`.

### J11 — A member declines NAP consent

- **Actor / goal:** A nation owner does not want to be bound by the Alliance's NAP.
- **Preconditions:** Active membership; treaty names the nation.
- **Steps:** Decline (`ALW-037`) → continue playing.
- **Expected:** The nation remains a full member; it is neither protected nor restricted by that NAP; it can consent to a later version.
- **Prohibited:** Removal, fine, admission refusal, cooldown or a "consent required for membership" message.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-079`.

### J12 — Two members of the same Alliance try to attack

- **Actor / goal:** An attacker wants to hit a neighbouring nation.
- **Preconditions:** Both nations share at least one active Alliance.
- **Steps:** Submit the attack (`ALW-038`).
- **Expected:** Blocked before execution with a reason naming the shared Alliance; no resource, readiness, OP or damage is consumed; audit written.
- **Prohibited:** A client-only check; a "leave alliance then attack" bypass within the same turn; a retaliation penalty.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-089`, `AAT-094`, `AAT-095`.

### J13 — A NAP-covered attack is blocked at execution

- **Actor / goal:** An attacker submits an attack that was valid at submission.
- **Preconditions:** Both nations were not allied at submission; one joins a party Alliance or the NAP activates before execution, covering both.
- **Steps:** Submission passes → execution revalidates (`ALW-039`).
- **Expected:** Blocked at execution; nothing consumed; the reason names the treaty and the boundary.
- **Prohibited:** Executing on the cached submission decision; partial damage then rollback.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-091`, `AAT-093`.

### J14 — A non-covered member attacks a covered nation

- **Actor / goal:** An attacker whose nation is outside the NAP wants to attack.
- **Preconditions:** Attacker is a non-covered member of a party Alliance; defender is covered by the other party.
- **Steps:** Submit the attack (`ALW-038`).
- **Expected:** The NAP does not block, because it covers only its recorded consenting set; all other rules still apply.
- **Prohibited:** Treating the attacker's alliance membership as coverage; treating the defender's alliance as extending protection to non-covered members of the other side.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-088`, `AAT-092`.

### J15 — A member leaves an Alliance

- **Actor / goal:** A member wants out.
- **Preconditions:** `ACTIVE_MEMBER`.
- **Steps:** Confirm leave (`ALW-005`).
- **Expected:** Membership ends atomically; future tax stops; treaty coverage ends at the boundary; national assets, cities, inventory and national treaties are untouched.
- **Prohibited:** A leader veto; an exit fee; asset confiscation; an automatic rejoin cooldown presented as a rule.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-013`, `AAT-014`.

### J16 — An Alliance dissolves while a NAP is active

- **Actor / goal:** A constitutionally authorised actor ends the Alliance.
- **Preconditions:** `ACTIVE`; lawful dissolution authority; active bilateral treaty.
- **Steps:** Confirm dissolution (`ALW-007`) → treaty ends as a whole (`ALW-033`) → archive (`ALW-048`).
- **Expected:** Members become `FORMER_MEMBER`; the treaty has no successor and no retroactive effect; the historical record remains.
- **Prohibited:** Distributing ARL value to players; transferring the treaty to a successor; deleting the constitution archive.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-017`, `AAT-018`, `AAT-109`.

### J17 — A rogue officer tries to escalate or drain

- **Actor / goal:** A position holder wants more power or the ARL balance.
- **Preconditions:** Holds some governance capability.
- **Steps:** Attempt to grant a permission they do not hold (`ALW-011`); attempt a general withdrawal (`ALW-049`); attempt a player-recipient "operational expense" (`ALW-026`).
- **Expected:** Each attempt is refused; the permission set is unchanged; nothing moves; the attempts are audited where sensitive.
- **Prohibited:** A wildcard grant; a self-promotion; a "treasury transfer" relabelled as upkeep; hiding the attempt from audit.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-030`, `AAT-031`, `AAT-069`.

### J18 — An ordinary member inspects governance

- **Actor / goal:** A member wants transparency without seeing private data.
- **Preconditions:** `ACTIVE_MEMBER`.
- **Steps:** Open the governance log (`ALW-041`) → view constitution versions, tax policy and permitted audit history.
- **Expected:** The member sees what the visibility class permits; applicant identities and unrelated private economy data are absent.
- **Prohibited:** A member-only "spy" view of other nations' balances; applicant names leaking to ordinary members.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-101`, `AAT-102`.

### J19 — A turn is interrupted mid-settlement

- **Actor / goal:** The player wants confidence that nothing was half-charged.
- **Preconditions:** A settlement failed atomically.
- **Steps:** Observe an incomplete-turn notice → the pipeline retries from the frozen snapshot (`ALW-046`).
- **Expected:** Exactly one assessment per event; no duplicate debit; the corrected statement reconciles.
- **Prohibited:** A second charge on retry; a silently abandoned turn; recomputing with a new snapshot.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-107`.

### J20 — A player asks for an unapproved feature

- **Actor / goal:** A player wants native voting, an announcement board, a Discord bot or a treasury withdrawal.
- **Preconditions:** None; each is Open or deferred.
- **Steps:** Attempt the action → receive a boundary explanation (`ALW-049`).
- **Expected:** The feature is not available; the explanation names the decision boundary without pretending it is a bug or a temporary outage.
- **Prohibited:** A hidden partial implementation; a "beta" toggle that grants the power; a Discord OAuth flow.
- **Rules / tests:** `AAT-106`, `AAT-110`.

### J21 — A member claims succession while the office is vacant

- **Actor / goal:** A member believes they should lead after the contact becomes inactive.
- **Preconditions:** Office record is `VACANT`; `UD-043` is Open; no approved succession or eligibility rule exists.
- **Steps:** Record the claim (`ALW-013`) → inspect the office record → attempt a privileged operation that would require the office.
- **Expected:** The claim is stored as evidence with actor, turn and timestamp; the office remains `UNRESOLVED`; no successor, heir or caretaker is appointed; the privileged operation is refused with an explanation that the succession policy is unresolved; the audit evidence remains available without becoming a permission.
- **Prohibited:** An automatic appointment; timestamp or transaction-order precedence; a constitution clause executed as a mechanic; a contact-record change treated as an office transfer; a hidden caretaker.
- **Rules / tests:** `ALL-057`, `UD-043`; `AAT-111`–`AAT-118`.

### J22 — A title holder tries to use the title as authority

- **Actor / goal:** A member with a decorative title wants to configure a permission or change a tax rate.
- **Preconditions:** The title exists in the constitution or a position description; the member holds no authorized capability for the attempted action.
- **Steps:** Attempt the tax change (`ALW-015`) → attempt a general permission assignment (`ALW-011`) → inspect the result.
- **Expected:** The title grants nothing; the tax change is refused unless the narrow tax-management capability is actually held; the general permission assignment is blocked under `UD-045`; nothing changes and the refusal is explained.
- **Prohibited:** Permission inference from a title; a constitution clause granting an engine permission; inheritance from a predecessor; a "proposal" silently becoming active.
- **Rules / tests:** `ALL-048`, `ALL-064`, `ALL-067`; `UD-045`; `AAT-119`–`AAT-124`.

## 9. Edge-case register (`ALE-001`–`ALE-065`)

Each edge case is a mandatory negative or ambiguity scenario. "Owner?" records whether the expected outcome depends on an unresolved owner decision; where it does, the companion applies the accepted boundary and does not decide the underlying question.

## 10. Failure codes and recovery contract

### 10.1 Codes defined or used by B-09

| Code | Meaning in the accepted corpus | Retriable | State on failure | Resources | Audit | Player notification | Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALF-01` | Name/tag collision (`ALL-014`) | Yes, with a new name | Founding rejected; nothing created | None | Founding rejection | `AN-11` | Choose another name |
| `ALF-02` | Treasury capacity exceeded (`ALL-105`, candidate only) | Only if a capacity model is ever approved | No debit | None | Treasury audit if applicable | `AN-11` | Not applicable today; no capacity exists |
| `ALF-03` | Invalid recipient for a candidate withdrawal (`AX-07`) | After correcting recipient | Proposal rejected | None | Treasury audit | `AN-11` | Not applicable; withdrawal is not approved |
| `ALF-04` | Invalid Discord URL (`ALL-166`; also named in `AX-19`) | Yes, with a valid URL | No link stored | None | Config audit | `AN-11` | Not applicable; link scope is unapproved |
| `ALF-05` | Insufficient funds for a candidate founding fee (`F-AL-002`) | After funding | Nothing created or charged | None | Founding rejection | `AN-11` | Not applicable; no fee is approved |
| `ALF-06` | `COOLDOWN_ACTIVE` (`F-AL-004`); also used for a second acceptance under the candidate single-Alliance baseline (`ALL-019`) | After the cooldown/rule is actually approved | Application rejected | None | Membership rejection | `AN-11` | Not applicable unless `UD-040`/`UD-044` approve the rule |
| `ALF-07` | `ALLIANCE_ROSTER_FULL` (`ALL-085`); also `SELF_APPROVAL_PROHIBITED` in `F-AL-005` | No (roster) / after correction (self-approval) | Application or action rejected | None | Relevant audit | `AN-11` | Resolve the collision; see §10.3 |
